name: Widescreen Battle Intro
description: Extends the battle intro's flash effect (wild encounters and stronger foes) across the whole window, so on non-4:3 displays it no longer plays inside a centered 4:3 square. Also extends the out-of-battle poison damage pulse to the whole window. Adds a FLASHLESS INTROS option that plays every battle intro as the Champion battle's flashless outward spiral, and a BLACK OUTRO option (ON by default) that replaces the post-battle white flash with a slow fade to black.
